svg.title: Planted faults, and what catches them
svg.desc: The sabotage battery plants faults into clean runs: results typed in from the paper, samples cut or padded to the paper’s count, synthetic data, and altered paper numbers. Of 116 viable plants, the coded checks alone catch 94; with one review, 106 (91.4%); with both reviews, 108 (93.1%). The reviews raised no false alarm in 12 reviews of untouched scripts. In the held-out set, 46 findings came from only one of the two reviews; each was read against the script by hand: 43 true, 2 borderline, 1 false, and no false or borderline finding decided a verdict.
svg.text: Planted faults, and what catches them
